qa.note: The article says the city of Hamburg bought the Wedel plant back from Vattenfall in 2019 and that Hamburger Energiewerke now runs it. GEM still shows Vattenfall Europe Power Management GmbH at 100 percent for all three units. I did not change the owner because the rules need two sources on a closed sale and I did not find the sale document.
